narrative: An email claims you won an international conference travel pass.

message.body: You have been selected for a complimentary student delegate pass to TechSummit 2026. Only 5 passes left. Confirm your registration code today.

evidence.label: Department Placement Chair
evidence.value: Placement chair has not received formal sponsor confirmation yet.

consequence_text.safe: You checked with your department chair first to verify whether the sponsor was legitimate.
consequence_text.unsafe: Rushing to claim unverified passes without checking official channels is unsafe in ambiguous scenarios.

teaching_point: Ambiguous opportunities require out-of-band verification before commitment.
